rows.source: Gatherer
rows.target: جامع لوازم
rows.rationale: Peter's land gathering includes assorted odds and ends in164:139-141, not only wild fruit. Supplies is broad; no change to source job identity or surrounding Bio facts.

rows.source: [pic=5]Er.. Ahem! Sorry Rascal… Didn’t mean to get all mushy in front of you…
rows.target: [pic=5]أه.. أحم! آسف يا راسكال… لم أقصد الاسترسال في العواطف أمامك…
rows.rationale: Augustus alone speaks/apologizes after his own sentimental remark367 and pause368. Singular أقصد restores his intent without changing Bucky's response or either man's relationship.

rows.source: [pic=8]And nothing rhymes with Plume!
rows.target: [pic=8]ولم أجد ما يقافي «طيران»!
rows.rationale: The complete156/157/159/176-183/194 chain adapts Zoom/COOM/Spoon/Poon to طيران/فيضان/أحضان/فروج نسوان. Move Scarlett's failed rhyme search to the actual target slogan ending; Penny's two retorts refute her excuse. Approved surname ريشة remains exact in every slogan.

rows.source: [pic=3]Then I started getting more venturous putting my whole paw inside! It shivered and coo’d!
rows.target: [pic=3]ثم صرت أجرأ وأدخلت كفي كلها! فارتعش وهدل!
rows.rationale: كف in the hand/paw sense takes feminine agreement under the Cairo Arabic Language Academy's الوسيط entry. كلها also matches the actual whole-paw translations930:860/935:1002. This is noun agreement; no biological gender is assigned to the plant.

rows.source: [pic=1]Have ya been Gossiping with the critters?
rows.target: [pic=1]هل دردشت مع المخلوقات؟
rows.rationale: This tutorial's action matches tfol-055 الدردشة and the notebook/native/managed prompts. The yes/no branches132/137 and story feedback134 remain intact. Capitalization alone is not the criterion: ordinary secret-telling in167/228 and384 remains valid context-specific gossip.

rows.source: Epiphany?
rows.target: «تجل»؟
rows.rationale: The choice asks about the same painting named تجل at144:175;197:156 explicitly calls it this piece. Reuse the complete existing artwork title without altering Finley's explanation or inventing a new work.

rows.source: … Not that I mind.
rows.target: … مع أنني لا أمانع.
rows.rationale: Violet recognizes Rascal's stalling259 yet does not mind continuing; Claire257 already knows. Restore a grammatical concessive negative without reversing willingness.

rows.source: Oops, sorry about that!
rows.target: أوه، أعتذر عن ذلك!
rows.rationale: Fisher's sex/pronouns are unestablished in tfol-016. First-person أعتذر preserves the apology after the bump198 without masculine self-description; subsequent202 and all later Fisher utterances stay neutral.

rows.source: [pic=4]I just kept it around as a good luck charm… Not that… it was particularly lucky or anything…
rows.target: [pic=4]كنت أحتفظ بها فحسب جالبة للحظ… مع أنها… لم تجلب حظا مميزا أو ما شابه…
rows.rationale: Oliver kept the horseshoe as a charm, while expressly qualifying its luck. Repair the malformed negative parenthesis and preserve its hesitant ellipses, past action, item referent and lack of proven luck effect under tfol-092.

rows.source: Two lovely ladies
rows.target: هُنَا حُلْوَتَانْ
rows.rationale: Connected MSA would pronounce medial dual nun as ni in the old order, giving six syllables. هنا first places the legitimate pause at the end: hu.naa.hul.wa.taan, five. Two lovely female participants remain explicit; obvious here framing was already present and authorized by the literary policy.

rows.source: [pic=3]Hmm, well there was that oooooone tiiiiiiiime.
rows.target: [pic=3]همم، حسنا، كانت هناك تلك المـــرة بعينهـــا.
rows.rationale: Violet singles out the particular party story, not the only party occasion. Claire calls it her favorite story334. بعينها retains specificity and stretched teasing delivery without unsupported exclusivity.

rows.source: Yeaaah, for once, I could use a break.
rows.target: أجللل، أحتاج إلى استراحة على غير عادتي.
rows.rationale: For once contrasts Violet's usual stamina with this exceptional need. على غير عادتي retains that contrast without claiming her first-ever break; the proposal هذه المرة alone would weaken the contrast.

rows.source: [pic=2]Obviously it’s gotta be a critter here, and really I’m just happy to see the spirit of The Saint living on.
rows.target: [pic=2]من الواضح أنه لا بد أن يكون أحد السكان هنا، ويسعدني حقا أن أرى روح القديس مستمرة فحسب.
rows.rationale: Add the missing أن يكون linkage. Augustus still infers a local giver while explicitly not knowing the identity in292-294; no supernatural explanation or known giver is asserted.

rows.source: This one’s from a new friend!
rows.target: هذه من أحد الأصدقاء الجدد!
rows.rationale: The generic class أحد الأصدقاء permits Augustus's immediate From you?718 to male Rascal before719 names Charlotte and Melody. أصدقاء retains friend rather than downgrading the relationship to acquaintances; its generic grammatical masculine does not disclose the unnamed sender's sex. Charlotte's established identity elsewhere stays unchanged.

rows.source: Anyways that’s about it. Once I’m spent, I’ll clean up my mess, with my tongue might I add, and call it a day!
rows.target: على أي حال، هذا كل شيء تقريبا. حين أُستنزف، أنظف ما خلفته، بلساني، إن جاز لي أن أضيف، وأكتفي بذلك!
rows.rationale: The speaker Rascal adds the tongue detail as an aside, not a condition about wanting to add something. Preserve all four actions and their order, first-person agency and exhaustion condition; punctuation bounds the aside.

rows.source: Hahahaaa. Y’know… For once I’m glad someone didn’t last too long.
rows.target: هاهاهااا. أتعلم… على غير عادتي، يسعدني أن أحدا لم يصمد طويلا.
rows.rationale: Mabel unusually welcomes a short encounter after its intensity822-827. Preserve both contrast with her usual preference and the negative duration, without an unsupported first-ever assertion.

rows.source: [pic=7]Yeah, just that they’re <waitfor=0.5>a bit <waitfor=0.5>unlike the other critters here.
rows.target: [pic=7]نعم، فهم <waitfor=0.5>مختلفون قليلا <waitfor=0.5>عن بقية السكان هنا.
rows.rationale: Mabel's folks771/787/822/826/854 are the mouse community, elaborated by matriarch777, succession789 and mice809. Plural فهم/مختلفون removes an invented pair. Both timing atoms remain in order around the same concepts.

rows.source: [pic=7]Heh, right. <waitfor=0.5>So for starters, <waitfor=0.5>they don’t really speak our tongue.
rows.target: [pic=7]هه، صحيح. <waitfor=0.5>بداية، <waitfor=0.5>هم لا يتحدثون لغتنا حقا.
rows.rationale: Same mouse-community referent as773; plural هم/يتحدثون preserves number and the inability to speak the shared language. Mabel's mother is one leader, not evidence of a two-parent referent.

rows.source: [pic=1]I always give him a friendly smile and wave though! <pause>I figured he must be shy.
rows.target: [pic=1]لكنني أبتسم له وألوح بود دائما! <pause>ظننت أنه لا بد أن يكون خجولا.
rows.rationale: Restore أن يكون after لا بد while retaining Penny's inference rather than factual knowledge, her friendly gestures and the pause separating them from her interpretation of the unnamed wolf.

rows.source: Not that I can blame you. Not a lot of critters last long with me…
rows.target: ولا أستطيع أن ألومك. فقليل من المخلوقات يصمدون طويلا معي…
rows.rationale: Scarlett reassures Rascal after his short stamina1. Cannot blame is retained explicitly by لا أستطيع أن ألومك, followed by the unchanged reason; no new blame or negated participant fact.

rows.source: [pic=4]We still have those benefits, might I add!
rows.target: [pic=4]وما زلنا نتمتع بتلك المنافع، إن جاز لي أن أضيف!
rows.rationale: Melody adds that the benefits continue after denying a romantic relationship703. The parenthetical does not make continuation conditional; original two-person plural agency and present continuation remain.

rows.source: And what on earth is Mia telling you.
rows.target: وما الذي تسمعه من ميا يا ترى.
rows.rationale: tfol-029 and the full955 spa scene establish no Mia sex/pronouns. Known male Rascal is the listener in891 and Mia the communicator in893. Hearing from Mia preserves that direction without third-person feminine agreement or an added pic token.

rows.source: [pic=3]That means they must have fixed the bridge!
rows.target: [pic=3]هذا يعني أنهم لا بد أن يكونوا قد أصلحوا الجسر!
rows.rationale: The same missing linkage as391:295/510:940 also occurs after plural أنهم. Read217-220: Oliver infers a completed bridge repair before reacting to the good news. أن يكونوا قد preserves plural actors, inferential necessity and completed repair; do not change the bridge or actor identity.
